authority: Candidate implementation; not Product Truth, production, clinical or empirical validation
title: Counterfactual decision model
summary: Concrete feasible configurations and supplied dose alternatives are compared ordinally. There is no universal summed score. The trace records admissibility, contribution/protected stimulus, future impact, disruption and reversibility; increment magnitude is compared only within the same physical dimension.
qualityAuthority: Runtime emits UNREVIEWED self-check. Independent case-specific reviewer owns quality labels; acceptable is never best-supported.
limits: Counterfactual labels are finite selector metadata, not exhaustive optimization
Some rejected larger changes have no executable recipe; they are not counted as admissible competitors
